sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Experiment: is the gray band (rows 27-29) passable? Move the selected 6x3 (rows 42-47, cols 30-32) UP repeatedly and see where it stops.
import copy
def obj63(f):
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='N' and n['pixels']==16:
            b=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
            if max(cs)-min(cs)<=2:  # 3-wide
                return min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    return None
print('before:', obj63(current_frame))
# move up up to 20 times
for i in range(20):
    r = action(['UP'])
    if r.get('board_changed') is False:
        print('stopped after', i, 'successful UP moves')
        break
print('after:', obj63(current_frame), 'step', current_frame.step)
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
